# Cancellation Payment Clause

Attaches to the original Payment Instruction. It follows the linked Order at `order` (default `/sources/order`) and records the settlement at `state` (default `/cancellationSettlement`). Its automatic observation runs when the embedded Order changes, when the connection or activation is updated, or when a matching payment event, request or outcome arrives. It waits for the linked Order's origin and snapshot, source readiness and the Payment Instruction ledger.

The settlement helper validates the immutable instruction and checks the groups' native cancellation decisions. It uses confirmed net paid amounts and the retained target to decide whether a refund is due. With all groups resolved it may request an additional capture of the retained charge or release the remaining hold, subject to payment setup, the configured capture gate and the provider. Pending or unknown requests block new money actions until their outcomes can be reconciled. The clause correlates payment requests by deterministic IDs so that replay does not issue an independent request for the same ledger and decision set.

The status and amounts reflect this Payment Instruction. A requested refund, capture or void is awaiting its guarantor outcome. A void releases authorization, while a refund returns captured funds. Confirmed balance fields come from the Payment Instruction ledger. The payment rail can reject an otherwise valid request.
